reviews.decision: AfterViewChecked drives the current subscript-message enter path: it detects message-kind changes, cancels a superseded WAAPI animation, restores the tagged inline resting opacity/translateY, animates only in browser with motion enabled and Element.animate support (300 ms with tagged easing), and cancels on destroy. The Material 16 lifecycle used Angular animation triggers; current code is an owned engine-free equivalent. Independent review found no additional blocker within this finite scope. Do not infer generated Angular animation marker parity or complete clean packed/floor/hydration/G11 clearance. This is a bounded current public-use source judgment; broader artifact, runtime and floor claims remain separate.
